crossRefs.note: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying…
Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man:
Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him…

translations.web: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
translations.bsb: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
translations.kjv: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
translations.asv: Deliver my soul, O Jehovah, from lying lips, And from a deceitful tongue.
